description: The Leader's Webby Wednesday directives of 2026-09-10 for restructuring the computer-engineering sections, each with its present state in the tree.
method: Each directive is a sentence of the Leader's, paraphrased shortly. `state` is: in-tree (the named section or file exists), in-tree-part (partly, with the remainder said), not-found, or open. State was read from `git ls-files` on main of 2026-10-10 and not from a build.
operating-principles: Make all information legible and considered before changes, so discovery favors recovery and migration over new duplicate implementations.
Work as an outside auditor of the actual intent and system, not trusting whatever accidental arrangement is in the repo.
Use staff for bounded mechanical work; do not make the lead enumerate every wrong byte.
Do not write new code for this recovery; assume the needed capability exists and recover or cannibalize it.
Take responsibility for all local dirt within the work; commit and push the intended work; stop downscaling or avoiding the authorized overhaul.
Treat the WSL lag as evidence that the operating system is failing and correct the underlying system.
Focus from the most basic computer-code, computer-data, computer-networking and computer-systems substrate outward, not backward from leaf applications.

Make every Founder prompt persistent source material in the work system, with bounded work, causal dependencies, a receiver, and an Actor-addressed Inbox refusal when it cannot proceed; repair the work system if it cannot; a huge undifferentiated ready-task count is evidence of failure.
Repair the Git engineering path so exact large migrations, commit and push use a working existing mechanism without ceremony, stalls or unowned local dirt.

After the urgent cut, reduce the cost and friction of this kind of work through shared data formats, code paradigms, network protocols, actor/resource/message/channel models, shared engines, servers, clients, platforms and applications, offices, duties, skills and runbooks.

directives.directive: Make computer-file-engineering-services-section a lawful direct data capability, recover the existing computer-file-engine, and route all file reads and writes through it.
directives.note: The section is seated under computer-data; that every file read and write routes through it is not verified here.

Rename the old content parent to computer-content-engineering-services-section.
Rename content-addressing to computer-content-address-engineering-services-section.
Rename media content to computer-media-engineering-services-section.
Rename/move audio to computer-audio-engineering-services-section.
Rename/move video rendering to computer-video-engineering-services-section.
directives.note: No section named computer-video-engineering-services-section exists; the media section holds audio and image sections only. Open: place video rendering under the media section.

directives.directive: Rename documents to computer-documents-engineering-services-section.
Rename articles to computer-article-engineering-services-section.
Rename ebook production to ebook-engineering-services-section, and move only the chapter-derivation script under it as derive-ebook-chapters-from-corpus.
Rename newsletter-issue production to email-newsletter-engineering-services-section.
Rename pandoc to pandoc-engineering-services-section.
Audit scholarly-literature capabilities and cannibalize each into its actual data-format or knowledge-system owner.
directives.note: No section named scholarly-literature remains; research-paper-authoring, research-document-metadata-admission and research-source-packet-admission services sit under documents. The audit record itself is not in the tree.

Put web advertising below Web as web-advertising-system-engineering-services-section.
Ensure the top-level computer-engineering boundary is only code, data, networking, and systems.
Cannibalize comparison into direct computer-data scripts or source rather than retain a whole comparison section.
directives.note: No comparison section remains at the top; text-comparison-service survives under text data.

directives.directive: Seat cryptography directly under computer-data as cryptographic-computer-data-engineering-services-section.
Remove the generic data-model shell; classify geospatial and RDF as computer content.
directives.note: No data-model section is in the tree; the triplet (RDF) serialized-content section exists; no geospatial section was found by name.

directives.note: The triplet section and the witness-journal RDF projection exist; legacy RDF engines sit under semiotic-computer-system-services-section/lib/legacy. Whether the lineage is recovered into one engine is not verified.

directives.note: A search-index renderer sits in computer-systems-publishing-engineering-services-section/apps/news-property; no data-publishing section was found and the audit record is not in the tree.

directives.note: CBOR, CSV, JSON, JSONL (EAVT beneath it), TOML, XML, YAML and others are sections beneath; EAVT sits under JSONL under JSON, matching the Leader's note that EAVT is JSONL is JSON.

directives.note: Under content; a flatfile agent resource also sits in the agent platform section.

directives.note: The computer-data section README and src hold the data engine; the typed-content section is beneath content. The seating has not been verified against the type-system source.

directives.directive: Cannibalize the typed-resource lineage into typed-content and data capability owners.
directives.note: No typed-resource section was found by name; the typed content section exists. No cannibalization record is in the tree.

Treat 'Directed Relation Entity Web' as a glossary/description term, not an application; inventory every DREW capability, move it to an appropriate owner, remove apps/drew and its package, and preserve the term at its glossary owner.
